verses.html: To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David. O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.text: To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David. O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.title: To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.

verses.html: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
verses.text: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

verses.html: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
verses.text: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?

verses.html: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
verses.text: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.

verses.html: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
verses.text: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

verses.html: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
verses.text: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

verses.html: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
verses.text: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

verses.html: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.text: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.html: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.
verses.text: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.

verses.html: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
verses.text: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
